title: Examining Salesperson Effort Allocation in Teams: A Randomized Field Experiment
authors: Jia Li; Noah Lim; Hua Chen
eligible_reason: Randomized field experiment: experimental conditions (coworker-ability pairings, Condition 1-3) are re-randomized day by day for each brand over 36 days, estimated by OLS of daily sales on salesperson FE, incentive x rank x condition indicators, shift, weekday, temperature and rain. No staggered absorbing binary adoption.
design_notes: README main model: lm(Sales ~ as.factor(GlobalID) + MI1 + ... + MI23 + Shift + Weekday + Temperature + Rain). 29 brands, 116 salespersons, 36 days.
data_files_note: README: due to an NDA, the authors provide simulated data generated by data_script.py.
software_notes: Python simulation script; R lm example in README
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available; screened from README, simulation script, shipped data and OpenAlex abstract.
